digest.component_or_area: Rebar Janitor remediation and verification workflow
propositions: Contributor and agent guidance must use each contributor's configured real DCO identity instead of bot identities except for explicitly automated workflows
Force flag bypasses all gates including future gates, but ticket-system invariants like open-children close prohibition remain non-bypassable
LLM verification must preserve flexible provider-independent parsing and self-healing while rejecting semantically empty results as valid review outcomes
Plan review cannot pass cleanly when ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant
ChatGPT-specific guidance must document safe Rebar usage when GitHub is read-only and native clone/Gerrit/tracker access is unavailable

Five decomposed work items (verify outcome tallying, DCO guidance, ChatGPT agent guide, force gate-bypass clarification, plan-review hierarchy fix) merged to main; verify_findings telemetry wiring scoped out and left open per decision
